rationale: Al Jazeera and Liberty Investigates submitted FOI requests to >150 UK universities (Part 1 published Apr 20, 2026; Part 2 on Oct 2023-Nov 2025 disciplinary counts resolves 2026-07-09). In Liberty Investigates Feb 2025 baseline FOI dataset, University College London led nationwide with 12 students investigated, followed by King's College London, LSE, and Cardiff, while Cambridge, Oxford, and Manchester saw major 2024-2025 protest crackdowns. Sum=0.53 reflects ~37+ active universities and potential newly disclosing institutions.
